name: [factory] godot-upgrade
description: Daily check for a new stable Godot release; pins it, runs the project's tests, fixes regressions and opens an auto-merge PR (managed by cezar-factory; do not edit in the cockpit)

task.prompt: Run the Godot upgrade workflow for {{project}} on {{date}}. The workflow steps do all the work; if there is no newer stable Godot release, do nothing.
